---
description: gm_set_entity as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
family: people
arguments:
  entity: "The person or thing."
  tier: "Its tier: principal, supporting, background, or one of the world's own."
  agent: "true to run their life on its own between scenes, false to stop."
  levels: "The detail each part of their life is kept at, by part (money, gear, needs and the rest), each a level or null for the world's own."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Sets a person's or a thing's tier, whether their life runs on its own, and the detail each part of their life is kept at. The answer says what changed and how they now stand.
